titel: Why Your Bunny's Hutch Is Too Small

beats.say: Why is that cute bunny hutch... way too *small?*
Rudi's bunny looks *bored.* So Rudi wants a fancier hutch!
So Rudi buys one with a *second floor.* The bunny just sits upstairs. Still bored.
Next, Rudi builds a *luxury* hutch, with a tiny TV. The bunny stands up... *bonk.*
Rabbits don't need luxury. They need *space.*
Experts say at least three by two *meters,* and one meter high, for two rabbits.
And that second floor? It doesn't *count.*
Without room to stand up tall, a rabbit's *spine* can bend.
Instead, make the hutch the *bedroom,* with a big run, open all day.
And if your friend says their bunny looks bored, just ask...
